name: Thiruvananthapuram
tagline: Kerala's capital, a royal city between hills and sea
summary: Thiruvananthapuram: Travancore's royal capital with Padmanabhaswamy Temple, Kovalam and Varkala beaches, museums and Kerala's government and IT hub.

history.overview: The district grew around the Travancore kingdom, whose rulers dedicated the realm to Sree Padmanabha. Under Marthanda Varma the capital was fixed here in the 18th century, and it became the capital of the Indian state in 1956.

timeline.event: Part of the Ay and later Venad kingdoms in the far south.
Marthanda Varma consolidates Travancore and rebuilds Padmanabhaswamy Temple.
Becomes the capital of the newly formed Kerala state.

unique: Two of Kerala's best-known beaches, Kovalam and Varkala
Western Ghats foothills with Ponmudi and Neyyar
A stronghold of classical arts and learning

bestTime.why: Cool, dry weather suits beaches and city sightseeing; February–March brings the Attukal Pongala.

lookFor: Padmanabhaswamy Temple and the fort area
